name: Jolia
architecture: 3D ViT (MultiModalAtlas, about 22M parameters) with frozen Qwen3-Embedding-8B text tower
default_feature_form: Nodule tokens at the marked location, one per scale
pretraining_data: Public CT-report pairs: CT-RATE, INSPECT (CT pulmonary angiography) and Merlin abdominal CT
objective: Contrastive vision-language (volume-report) with per-organ concept alignment
weights: Yes; Hugging Face license 'other' (RAIL-M not confirmed)
reference: Khlaut J, Corbière C, Callard B, et al. Jolia: concept-level vision-language alignment for 3D CT contrastive learning. arXiv 2606.24570 [preprint]. 2026.

name: Pillar0-ChestCT
default_feature_form: Nodule tokens at the marked location, one per scale
pretraining_data: Chest CT, University of California San Francisco (private)
weights: Yes; ECL-2.0 on Hugging Face (article states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
reference: Agrawal KK, Liu L, Lian L, et al. Pillar-0: a new frontier for radiology foundation models. arXiv 2511.17803 [preprint]. 2025.

name: Pillar0-Sybil-1.5
architecture: Atlas 3D ViT encoder of Pillar0-ChestCT with a risk head
default_feature_form: Nodule tokens at the marked location, one per scale
pretraining_data: Pillar0-ChestCT pretraining, then NLST low-dose CT fine-tuning for lung cancer risk
pretraining_scale: 86411 chest CT (Pillar0-ChestCT pretraining) plus 28162 NLST LDCT (fine-tuning)
objective: Contrastive vision-language pretraining, then supervised lung cancer risk fine-tuning
weights: Yes; ECL-2.0 on Hugging Face (article states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
reference: Agrawal KK, Liu L, Lian L, et al. Pillar-0: a new frontier for radiology foundation models. arXiv 2511.17803 [preprint]. 2025.

name: CT-FM
input: Whole CT at native spacing, cropped to the body
pretraining_data: Public CT from the NCI Imaging Data Commons (69 cohorts)
overlap: LIDC-IDRI, LIDC-path (parent collection; excluded); LUNA25-Dev, NSCLC-Radiomics, NSCLC-Radiogenomics, CPTAC-LUAD, RIDER Lung CT, Lung-PET-CT-Dx, LUNGx, LUAD-CT-Survival (plausible, not itemized; included; excluded in strict sensitivity analysis)
reference: Pai S, Hadzic I, Bontempi D, et al. Vision foundation models for computed tomography. arXiv 2501.09001 [preprint]. 2025.

name: Merlin
architecture: I3D ResNet-152 with Clinical Longformer text encoder
default_feature_form: Mean of the central 2×2×2 last-layer tokens
objective: Contrastive vision-language (image-report) plus supervised EHR phenotypes
reference: Blankemeier L, Kumar A, Cohen JP, et al. Merlin: a computed tomography vision–language foundation model and dataset. Nature 2026;652(8112):1318–1328.

name: CT-CLIP
architecture: CTViT 3D ViT with CXR-BERT text encoder
pretraining_data: Chest CT with reports, CT-RATE (single institution)
reference: Hamamci IE, Er S, Wang C, et al. Generalist foundation models from a multimodal dataset for 3D computed tomography. Nat Biomed Eng 2026;10(8):1610–1628.

name: Models Genesis
reference: Zhou Z, Sodha V, Pang J, Gotway MB, Liang J. Models Genesis. Med Image Anal 2021;67:101840.

name: ResNet50-SWS
pretraining_data: Low-dose screening CT nodule patches, Duke Lung Cancer Screening dataset
objective: Supervised (nodule warm start, then malignancy fine-tuning)
reference: Tushar FI, Wang A, Dahal L, et al. Reproducible benchmarking for lung nodule detection and malignancy classification across multiple low-dose CT datasets. arXiv 2405.04605 [preprint]. 2024.

name: FMCIB
input: 50×50×50 voxels at 1 mm around the seed point
pretraining_data: Lesion-centered CT patches, DeepLesion (NIH Clinical Center)
reference: Pai S, Bontempi D, Hadzic I, et al. Foundation model for cancer imaging biomarkers. Nat Mach Intell 2024;6(3):354–367.

name: MedicalNet
input: 128-mm crop at native spacing, resized to 96×96×96 voxels
pretraining_data: CT and MRI segmentation datasets (3DSeg-8 extended to 23 datasets; 23-dataset checkpoint)
overlap: Unknown for every cohort (dataset list of the 23-dataset checkpoint not published; included; excluded in strict sensitivity analysis)
reference: Chen S, Ma K, Zheng Y. Med3D: transfer learning for 3D medical image analysis. arXiv 1904.00625 [preprint]. 2019.

name: DINOv3
architecture: ViT-B/16 (12 layers, width 768), distilled from the 7B DINOv3 model
input: 128-mm crop at native spacing; sections resized to 224×224 pixels
default_feature_form: Mean of the class tokens of the five central axial sections
pretraining_data: Natural web images, LVD-1689M (no medical data)
reference: Siméoni O, Vo HV, Seitzer M, et al. DINOv3. Trans Mach Learn Res 2026. https://openreview.net/forum?id=2NlGyqNjns.

name: MedDINOv3
input: 128-mm crop at native spacing; sections resized to 224×224 pixels
default_feature_form: Mean of the class tokens of the five central axial sections
pretraining_data: Axial CT slices from 16 public CT datasets (CT-3M)
overlap: NSCLC-Radiomics, NSCLC-Radiogenomics (plausible, not itemized; included; excluded in strict sensitivity analysis)
reference: Li Y, Wu Y, Lai Y, et al. MedDINOv3: how to adapt vision foundation models for medical image segmentation? arXiv 2509.02379 [preprint]. 2025.

name: MedSigLIP
input: 128-mm crop at native spacing; sections resized to 448×448 pixels
default_feature_form: Mean of the image embeddings of the five central axial sections
pretraining_data: Medical image-text pairs (chest radiographs, dermatology, ophthalmology, histopathology, CT and MRI slices) plus natural image-text pairs
pretraining_scale: >33 million medical image-text pairs (635000 across modalities and 32.6 million histopathology patches)
weights: Yes (gated); Health AI Developer Foundations terms
reference: Sellergren A, Kazemzadeh S, Mahvar F, et al. An open vision-language model for diverse medical applications. Nat Med 2026;32(10):3695–3704.

name: Lingshu
input: 128-mm crop at native spacing; sections resized to multiples of 28 pixels
default_feature_form: Mean of the merged patch embeddings of the five central axial sections
pretraining_data: Open and synthetic medical multimodal data, 12 or more modalities (includes CT and DeepLesion)
pretraining_scale: about 3.75 million open plus 1.30 million synthetic multimodal samples
objective: Multimodal instruction tuning and reinforcement learning
reference: Xu W, Chan HP, Li L, et al. Lingshu: generalist foundation model for unified multimodal medical understanding and reasoning. IEEE Trans Pattern Anal Mach Intell 2026. doi:10.1109/TPAMI.2026.3730310.

name: BiomedCLIP
architecture: ViT-B/16 (224 pixels) with PubMedBERT text encoder
input: 128-mm crop at native spacing; sections resized to 224×224 pixels
default_feature_form: Mean of the class tokens of the five central axial sections
pretraining_data: Biomedical figure-caption pairs from PubMed Central (PMC-15M)
reference: Zhang S, Xu Y, Usuyama N, et al. A multimodal biomedical foundation model trained from fifteen million image–text pairs. NEJM AI 2025;2(1):AIoa2400640.

name: nnFoundation-CNN
default_feature_form: Mean of features within 32 mm of the nodule
pretraining_data: CT, MRI and PET volumes from 125 sources (dataset list only in part)
pretraining_scale: 2.1 million CT, MRI and PET volumes
overlap: Unknown for every cohort (pretraining data listed only in part; included; excluded in strict sensitivity analysis)
reference: Harsy CU, Wald T, Gotkowski K, et al. nnFoundation: 3D foundation models for radiology. arXiv 2609.26924 [preprint]. 2026.

name: nnFoundation-ViT
default_feature_form: Mean of features within 16 mm of the nodule
pretraining_data: CT, MRI and PET volumes from 125 sources (dataset list only in part)
pretraining_scale: 2.1 million CT, MRI and PET volumes
overlap: Unknown for every cohort (pretraining data listed only in part; included; excluded in strict sensitivity analysis)
reference: Harsy CU, Wald T, Gotkowski K, et al. nnFoundation: 3D foundation models for radiology. arXiv 2609.26924 [preprint]. 2026.

name: Sybil
architecture: 3D ResNet-18 with attention pooling and hazard head (5-member ensemble)
input: Resampled to 0.703×0.703×2.5 mm, cropped or padded to 256×256×200 voxels
default_feature_form: Nodule tokens, averaged over the five ensemble members
pretraining_data: Low-dose screening CT, National Lung Screening Trial
reference: Mikhael PG, Wohlwend J, Yala A, et al. Sybil: a validated deep learning model to predict future lung cancer risk from a single low-dose chest computed tomography. J Clin Oncol 2023;41(12):2191–2200.
